verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes a native automation capability: Rovo AI can create custom automations, including "rules that move work forward", and automation keeps Jira up to date from connected tools such as Bitbucket and Slack. The evidence is only feature-page copy, though. It never documents the trigger, condition and action model or which events can fire rules. Missing for 10: documentation of event triggers, conditions and actions, rule-builder depth and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
